The /backtests/export/orders API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

text/csv - Orders of the backtest, sorted by time.
content string
One row per order. The Time column is in UTC.
Example 
Time,Symbol,Price,Quantity,Type,Status,Value,Tag
2024-01-02T15:00:00Z,IWM,195.236280785,500,Market,Filled,97618.1403925,""

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
